readme.run: Segment a T1-weighted brain MRI and write a printable mesh
notes: Writes brain-fraction.nii (or segmentation.nii), brain2print.stl and brain2print.mz3.
MindGrab's weights are inside its WebAssembly; no network connection is required.
Add --help for the model, simplification, smoothing and component settings.
Segmentation runs on the CPU and takes about a minute and up to 4 GB of memory.
Input is NIfTI only: convert DICOM with dcm2niix first, or use the web app.
Brain2Print is research software. Check the mesh before printing. Please cite:
Rorden C, McCormick M, Hanayik T, Masoud M, Plis SM. brain2print AI powered web
tool for creating 3D printable brain models. Scientific Reports. 2025;15:15664.
Fani A, Doan M, Le I, et al. MindGrab: A spectrally-motivated architecture for
accessible deep learning in neuroimaging. NeuroImage. 2026;338:122074.
